iconicAnchor.label: Gesellschaft und Wirtschaft and the Isotype Picture Dictionary
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Otto Neurath, Marie Neurath, Gerd Arntz, and the Isotype team
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The charts and production archive show standardized pictograms designed as repeatable units for representing social facts quantitatively.

sources.title: Society and economy
supports: Isotype pictograms were designed as repeatable building blocks for charts.
The Picture Dictionary reduced each symbol to the characteristics needed to state facts.

sources.title: Isotype-neurath.jpg
supports: The exact audited file demonstrates repeated equal-scale pictograms arranged for comparison.
Its visual structure separates statistical counting from a standalone wayfinding icon.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches repeated pictograms, quantitative, consistent scale, comparison, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/isotype-statistical-graphics/reference-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
